content:
ROOT_CAUSE: AgentgatewayPolicy enforces a 3 req/min limit with burst 1 on /v1, so POST /v1/chat/completions exceeds the quota and returns HTTP 429.
CONFIRM: kubectl get agentgatewaypolicy -A -o yaml | grep -A20 -E 'rateLimit|/v1'
FIX: Raise the AgentgatewayPolicy rate limit (and burst) on /v1 enough for expected chat/completions traffic, then apply the updated policy.
WORKAROUND: Space client requests under 3/min or temporarily remove/bypass that policy while you update it.
